drawings.description: Petit carré quadrillé par les deux axes, sommets marqués $s_0$ (en haut à droite), $s_1$ (en haut à gauche), $s_2$ (en bas à gauche), $s_3$ (en bas à droite).
drawings.kind: square on two axes with labelled vertices
drawings.notes: A small square crossed by the two axes; vertices s_0 (top right), s_1 (top left), s_2 (bottom left), s_3 (bottom right), the corners inked as points.

drawings.description: En marge gauche : une ellipse, un point marqué $d_\zeta$ sur elle, et deux droites issues de ce point, l'une tangente, l'autre sécante.
drawings.kind: ellipse with a point and two lines through it
drawings.notes: A tilted ellipse, a heavy point d_zeta on it, and two lines through the point: one meeting the ellipse again (secant), the other along it (tangent), as read.

drawings.description: Petit croquis en perspective : trois vecteurs $f_1$, $f_2$, $f_3$ issus d'une origine, un segment marqué $1 - \zeta$, et un plan marqué $H_\zeta$.
drawings.kind: perspective sketch: three vectors, a segment, a plane
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop; every stroke ends on the computed points. From the origin: an arrow to the right (f_1), an arrow obliquely up to the right (f_2), and a vertical stroke up (no arrowhead visible); a long stroke from the origin up to a heavily inked apex, and a stroke from the apex down to the tip of f_2; a heavy segment from the vertical stroke up to the right, crossing both, and a short stroke from the vertical to the right just under it. The labels f_1 and f_2 stand at the right of the tips; the label at the left of the vertical stroke reads f_3 (long f with subscript 3, like the other two), not 1 - zeta as placed before: the vertical stroke is then f_3, and the apex is not a vector tip. The labels 1 - zeta and H_zeta of the transcription are not located with certainty (the overinked marks at the apex and above f_2 and f_1 may carry them) and are left out; the overinked marks themselves are left out. Still a reading: which stroke is f_3 and what the apex is. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the label left of the vertical stroke is f_3 (a long f with the subscript 3, the same hand as f_1 and f_2 at the right), as drawn. Not checked by a reader. A small inscription just under the inked apex, which may be the 1 - zeta of the transcription, is still not read.

drawings.description: En bas à gauche : deux axes $e_1$ (horizontal) et $e_3$ (vertical), un vecteur $e_2$ et la droite $D_\zeta = \mathcal{O}_S(1,\zeta)$ issus de l'origine.
drawings.kind: axes e_1, e_3 with vector e_2 and line D_zeta
drawings.notes: Axes e_1 (horizontal, arrow) and e_3 (vertical, arrow); from the origin the vector e_2 and the line D_zeta = O_S(1, zeta) (its label continues outside the crop as text).

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, deux droites horizontales marquées $\Delta=0$ coupées par une courbe marquée $2=0$.
drawings.kind: two lines Delta = 0 cut by a curve 2 = 0
drawings.notes: Two nearly horizontal lines cut by a curve that crosses them; small cross marks on the curve; 2 = 0 at the top of the curve (and again at its foot). The Delta = 0 labels are at the right ends of the lines, just outside the crop: placed at the edge.

drawings.description: deux rangées de tirets, et un hexagone.
drawings.kind: hexagon and two rows of dashes
drawings.notes: An open-stroked hexagon, and two rows of dashes to the right of and below it.

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un cône (triangle et ellipse) dont le sommet est marqué d'une étoile.
drawings.notes: In the left margin: a cone drawn as a triangle and an ellipse, its apex marked by a star; a stroke crosses it and a short dashed stroke inside.

drawings.description: dans la marge, un petit parallélogramme de vecteurs, en partie pointillé.
drawings.kind: small parallelogram of vectors, partly dotted
drawings.notes: Two vectors from a point (upwards right and to the right), completed into a parallelogram by dotted strokes (a vertical dotted stroke, a dashed top side and a dashed diagonal).

drawings.description: dans la colonne du milieu du tableau, un dessin de graphe à quatre sommets par ligne : quatre points ; deux points et une arête épaisse ; un point et un triangle ; deux arêtes disjointes ; un carré.
drawings.kind: five graphs on four vertices (column of a table)
drawings.notes: The sheet is written upside down in the scan; the figure is drawn in reading position (crop turned by 180 degrees). One graph on four vertices per row of the table, top to bottom: four isolated points; two points and one heavy edge with its end points; one point and a triangle; two disjoint edges with their end points; a square. Every edge is drawn between the vertices placed once. The formulas to the left and the counts to the right of each graph are in the array of the transcription and are not drawn; the long oblique stroke that crosses the page is not drawn. A faint unfinished second square to the left of the square (two pencil strokes) is left out. Id 05-6: existing ids are not renumbered. Overlaid 2026-11-12 (Opus 5.5) on a 400 dpi colour render: the redraw matches the page; nothing corrected. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: rot180 (the page is written upside down; the crop is turned to reading position)
